title: Microsoft Entra ID: Sign In With Work Accounts | Orchard Core
description:
People who work for an organization already have an account in Microsoft Entra ID. Asking them to keep a separate password for your site adds one more credential to manage.

The Microsoft Entra ID feature of Orchard Core adds a sign-in button to the login page. People sign in at Microsoft, and the site matches them to a linked user, links an account with the same email address, or registers a local account when external registration is allowed.

In this video:
• How the sign-in works
• Registering the app in the Azure portal
• The tenant ID and who can sign in
• Enabling the feature
• Configuring Display Name, AppId, TenantId and CallbackPath
• The sign-in button on the login page
• Matching the person to a user
• Roles from Entra ID groups
